evidence: Matches the 'Tests' label and modifies the functional test framework (test_framework/spenders.py) as well as the fuzz script assets test minimizer harness.
rationale: Adds coverage for legacy script interpreter edge cases to script test assets and extracts spender test logic into a shared test framework helper. The author notes that 'None of the current script assets catch an interpreter that gets these wrong' and the change enables bitcoin-core/qa-assets#297, but does not fix an active defect or flaky test in Bitcoin Core itself.
